verdict.rationale: Square provides a Payouts API for settlement data and separate Refunds and Disputes APIs, plus marketing copy about seeing 'all your sales in one report' to reduce reconciliation effort, but there's no dedicated documentation showing an itemized report that ties bank deposits to fees, refunds, and chargebacks in one place.  missing for 10: explicit itemized payout/settlement report schema breaking down fees, refunds, chargebacks; documentation linking payout amounts directly to bank deposit records; independent confirmation from finance-ops users that reconciliation works end-to-end.
